The curve is perfect for my eyes, you don't have to squeeze it super hard to get a curl, and like another reviewer said, it actually curls instead of "folding" like a lot of other curlers do. reviews.t: This curler is Wonderful!
reviews.x: I never use eyelash curlers much because mine are so short. I always pinch myself, which is very unpleasant to say the least. With this curler I had no problem what so ever hitting every last and reaching the base, while missing my eyelid. Great product all around! Would definitely recommend this to my friends as a must have.

reviews.t: Bella and Bear Will Have Them Staring
reviews.x: I barely ever bothered with an eyelash curler. They pinch, poke, and generally a pain to fool around with. So when I received this one I was doubtful that I would like it, much less enjoy using this product. I am a good sport however, and gave it a go. First there was NO pinching. What a relief. It is quite painful to pinch your eyelids. No pinching, no pulling, and a breeze to use. Just 10 seconds and bam you have awesome looking eyelashes without all the fuss. I am so glad to have found this.

reviews.t: Curls my Asian lashes!
reviews.x: I’m so happy with this eyelash curler! I am Asian so my lashes aren’t easy to curl. This eyelash curler worked beyond my expectations. It curled my lashes within a few seconds without having to clamp down hard on the curler. Holding down for about 10 seconds did the trick!

I could only grasp the very end  of my lashes and in the end I couldn't even notice any difference. But that is certainly not the case with this one! I love it! claims.text: Many reviewers say this curler gives a strong, effective curl, even on stubborn or hard-to-curl lashes.
Several reviewers praise the fit and curve, saying it suits their eye shape and reaches lashes without pinching.
A few reviewers report pain, pinching, or eyelash damage, including lashes being ripped out or cut off.
Some reviewers describe the build quality as solid and well made.
A few reviewers found it no better than a standard curler or less impressive than expected.

qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some report no pinching or pulling [1][2], while another says it ripped out lashes [3].

Another reviewer reported no problem missing their eyelid [1].

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.answer: Reviews indicate it fits different eye shapes, including inset eyes and eyelids other curlers didn't fit [1][5], and it works without pinching or poking [3][4]. However, one reviewer notes it takes practice to get comfortable with [1].
